items.text: I tested positive this morning for COVID-19. I requested the test today after exhibiting symptoms while at home on leave. My symptoms are mild, and I am following my physician’s directions. 1/7

My last meeting with @POTUS was on Tues 12/21, more than a week before my symptoms began. I tested negative that very morning. I have not been in the Pentagon since Thursday, where I met briefly & only with a few staff. We were properly masked & socially distanced throughout. 5/7

Nothing is more important to me or to this Department than the health and well-being of our Service members, the civilian workforce, and DOD families. I am committed to taking care of our people and ensuring the readiness and resilience of our Force.
The Department is examining this decision closely and evaluating our policies to ensure we continue to provide seamless access to reproductive health care as permitted by federal law.

As of today, #988Lifeline, the new national suicide prevention lifeline number, is live nationwide. Mental health is health. Period. And one suicide is simply too many. 

All you have to do is call or text ‘988’ — or start a chat at https://t.co/JK7B7Xolop. https://t.co/wHNICtqKv8

Very glad to see @POTUS sign the PACT Act into law today: the most significant expansion of care, benefits, & services for veterans exposed to toxins in 30+ years. It's going to have a real impact on the health & wellbeing of our veterans, their families, caregivers, & survivors.

Last week, the 🇺🇸 @USNavy, the 🇯🇵 Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force, and the 🇰🇷 ROK Navy jointly participated in a missile warning and ballistic missile search and tracking exercise off the coast of the Pacific Missile Range Facility (PMRF) in Hawaii.

This exercise shows how committed our three nations are to furthering trilateral cooperation to respond to DPRK challenges, protecting shared security and prosperity, and bolstering the rules-based international order.
It was great to host my friend, @SecVetAffairs, for a virtual discussion about suicide prevention and mental health with MSO/VSO leaders yesterday. https://t.co/CmgVRDuISv

The @deptofdefense and the @USNavy remain focused on the health and safety of our military families and the people of Hawaii. To that end, I'm pleased to announce U.S. Navy Rear Adm. John Wade as the Commander of the Joint Task Force – Red Hill. https://t.co/fgCrWYI1Ma

1/
The SCOTUS ruling on reproductive health has real readiness, recruiting, & retention implications for the Force. We've heard concerns from many of our people about the uncertainty they now face in accessing reproductive health care, including abortion services. https://t.co/Ed1Dte3ciD

3/ 
- Service members and their families have the time and space they need to make private reproductive health care decisions, 
- DoD health care providers should not be personally liable for performing their official duties,

4/
- Service members and their families, who regularly move to meet operational requirements, should be able to access reproductive health care, 
- All military medical treatment facilities will offer dedicated hours for walk-in contraceptive care.

5/
Simply put: Our greatest strength is our people. There is no higher priority than taking care of our people, and ensuring their health and well-being.

Before leaving 🇮🇩 Indonesian, I met National Armed Forces Commander, Andika Perkasa. With over 200 joint military engagements each year, our bilateral training has never been stronger. Exercise Super Garuda Shield expanded to include over 4,000 combined forces from 14 countries. https://t.co/0Wk9PCUtgJ
Thank you to @DOD_Policy for hosting a successful Deterrence Strategy Committee Table-Top Exercise with our allies from the Republic of Korea.  https://t.co/rfS2V2Ab6J

Mental health IS health. Maintaining the readiness of our force requires that we focus on physical AND mental health. We must encourage one another to reach out for help when needed & continue to combat the stigma around mental health in our military. #MentalHealthAwarenessMonth https://t.co/PnVoA2SgTS

Taking care of our people is a top priority of mine. Signing of the Brandon Act will provide service members better access to mental health treatment for any reason, at any time, while also working to reduce the stigma associated with seeking help. https://t.co/pfFQB0eeZ6

Wheels down in Australia where I will attend AUSMIN 2023 w/ @SecBlinken & Australian counterparts & engage w/ troops participating in the 10th iteration of Exercise Talisman Sabre. With over 30K personnel from 13 nations, we’re committed to maintaining a #FreeandOpenIndoPacific. https://t.co/XUvV3tn8Lr

It was an honor to spend time with troops participating in exercise Talisman Sabre. The Unbreakable Alliance shared by our two nations 🇺🇸 🇦🇺 is fueled by the dedication of our service members. Thank you for your daily service & sacrifice. https://t.co/rynZRoQHv0

Together, you’re bolstering deterrence by building capability alongside allies and partners. I’m proud that we have 13 countries participating in this year’s exercise who share that common vision for the region. https://t.co/6zJXmY0DSm

We tragically lost service members during a training exercise in Australia overnight. These Marines served our country with courage and pride, and my thoughts and prayers are with their families today, with the other troops who were injured in the crash, and with the entire USMC family.

September is #SuicidePreventionAwareness Month. Mental health is health and we'll continue to find ways to prevent suicide and ensure support is within reach for the entire military community. https://t.co/7S6V1nnOhc

Last week, I convened senior leaders for an update on JTF-RH’s efforts to safely and expeditiously defuel the Red Hill Facility, where I reiterated our long-term commitment to protecting human health and environmental stewardship in Hawaii.

https://t.co/cQzaqoZRC7

AUKUS is a once in a generation opportunity that will promote peace and security throughout the Indo-Pacific. Today, we endorsed several new efforts, to include the Maritime Autonomous Experimentation and Exercise Series to lead our partnership forward. https://t.co/MWk3CGig73
